module rtlpp_10473
 (input         clk, reset,
  input  [7:0]  x_in,
  output reg signed [10:0] y_real, y_imag);

  reg signed [10:0]  accu;               
 
  reg signed [18:0]  im [0:5]; 
  reg signed [18:0]  re [0:5];  
 
  reg signed [18:0]  x57, x111, x160, x200, x231, x250; 
  reg signed [18:0]  x5, x25, x110, x125, x256; 
  reg signed [7:0]   x, x_0;
  reg [1:0] state;
  reg [4:0] count;

  parameter Start=0, Load=1, Run=2;

  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin 
    if (reset) begin              
      state <= Start;
      count <= 0;
      x_0 <= 0;
      accu <= 0;        
      y_real  <= 0;
      y_imag  <= 0;
    end else begin
      case (state)
        Start : begin        
          state <= Load;
          count <= 1;
          x_0 <= x_in;       
          accu <= 0;        
          y_real  <= 0;
          y_imag  <= 0;
        end
        Load : begin 
          if (count == 8)     
            state <= Run;
          else begin
            state <= Load;
            accu <= accu + x;
            count <= count + 1;
          end
        end
        Run : begin 
          if (count == 15) begin 
            y_real  <= accu;       
            y_imag  <= 0;  
            state <= Start;      
          end else begin
            y_real  <= (re[0] >>> 8) + x_0; 
            y_imag  <= (im[0] >>> 8);     
            state <= Run;
            count <= count + 1;
          end
        end
      endcase
    end
  end

  always @(posedge clk) begin 
    x <= x_in;

    re[0] <= re[1] + x160;   
    re[1] <= re[2] - x231;   
    re[2] <= re[3] - x57;   
    re[3] <= re[4] + x160;   
    re[4] <= re[5] - x231;   
    re[5] <= -x57;             

    im[0] <= im[1] - x200;   
    im[1] <= im[2] - x111;   
    im[2] <= im[3] - x250;
    im[3] <= im[4] + x200;
    im[4] <= im[5] + x111;
    im[5] <= x250;             
  end

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    x160 <= x5 <<< 5;        
    x200 <= x25 <<< 3;       
    x250 <= x125 <<< 1;      
    x57 <= x25 + (x <<< 5); 
    x111 <= x110 + x;       
    x231 <= x256 - x25;
  end

  always @* begin
    x5 = (x <<< 2) + x;  
    x25 = (x5 <<< 2) + x5;        
    x110 = (x25 <<< 2) + (x5 <<< 2);
    x125 = (x25 <<< 2) + x25;      
    x256 = x <<< 8;
  end
endmodule
